title: Access the OmicIDX omicx metadata database
text: Access OmicIDX omics metadata database R omicidxr package provides convenient interface query explore OmicIDX metadata database, comprehensive resource omics dataset metadata. Built top DuckDB, enables fast, efficient queries large-scale genomics metadata without downloading entire database. users GEOmetadadb SRAdb, omicidxr offers modern alternative cloud-native access, eliminating need manage large local SQLite files.

title: Access the OmicIDX omicx metadata database
text: 🚀 Fast queries powered DuckDB’s columnar storage ☁️ Cloud-native access remote databases via S3-compatible storage 🔌 Zero setup – connect public OmicIDX database instantly 🧰 Two interfaces – use functional-style connections R6 client 🔍 Full SQL support plus dplyr/dbplyr integration 💾 -memory persistent – choose storage backend

title: Access the OmicIDX omicx metadata database
text: R6 client provides object-oriented interface automatic table discovery:
code: library(omicidxr)  # Create a new client (connects to the public database) oidx <- OmicidxClient$new()  # See what tables are available oidx$list_tables()  # Usse the tbl() method to get dplyyr table references oidx$tbl("src_sra_studies") |>   dplyr::count(study_type, sort = TRUE) |>   dplyr::collect()  # Execute raw SQL queries oidx$query("     SELECT COUNT(*) as transcriptome_study_count     FROM src_sra_studies     WHERE study_type = 'Transcriptome Analysis'")

title: Access the OmicIDX omicx metadata database
text: control, use lower-level functional interface:
code: library(omicidxr) library(dplyr)  # Establish connection con <- connect_omicidx()  # List all available tables list_tables(con)  # Use dplyr to build queries dplyr::tbl(con, "src_sra_experiments") |>   dplyr::filter(library_strategy == "RNA-Seq") |>   dplyr::count(platform, sort = TRUE) |>   dplyr::collect()  # Execute SQL directly DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "   SELECT platform, COUNT(*) as n    FROM src_sra_experiments   WHERE library_strategy = 'RNA-Seq'   GROUP BY platform   ORDER BY n DESC ")  # Clean up when done DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

title: Omicidx DuckDB Client (R6) — OmicidxClient
text: main class interacting OmicIDX data resource. provides methods connecting Omicidx DuckDB database, listing tables, retrieving dplyr table references, executing SQL queries. OmicidxClient class uses R6 encapsulate functionality connecting querying Omicidx DuckDB database. provides user-friendly interface accessing data stored database. typical workflow involve: Creating new OmicidxClient object using new() method. Listing available tables using list_tables() method. Accessing specific tables using tbl() method referencing tables tbls field. need execute custom SQL queries, can use query() method. underlying DuckDB database actually stored S3-compatible object store, client abstracts away details connecting database. database need downloaded locally; data also stored cloud queried remotely via DuckDB. want persist DuckDB instance locally (e.g., cache query results), can provide local file path creating OmicidxClient object.
